verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a personal agent that acts on connected issues, messages and files, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows single-item actions (create an issue, comment, file a bug), read-only summarization and briefings, and scheduled jobs. Nothing documents applying one operation across many items at once, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
